article.title: Senator Femi Adesanya-Kuti moves to ADC
article.text: Senator Femi Adesanya-Kuti, representing Ogun Demo District 1, on Friday moved to the African Democratic Congress. Speaking after collecting his membership card in Abeokuta, Adesanya-Kuti said: "I have resigned from the APC and joined the ADC, where my vision for Ogun is better served."
